info.title: Agent Gateway API
info.description:
Agent Gateway lets approved AI assistants, automation tools, and external apps use selected Relewise capabilities through My Relewise without sharing Dataset API Keys.

Authenticate with a My Relewise Personal Access Token or OAuth access token as a bearer token. Dataset-scoped operations also check the token's Dataset access, the Dataset Access Policy, enabled Agent Gateway areas, and the user's My Relewise permissions.

Agent Gateway is designed for AI agents as well as developers. When Dataset-specific values are unknown, use the available discovery operations instead of guessing identifiers, languages, currencies, Data Keys, or Classification Values. Operation descriptions identify intended use, alternatives, and side effects.

For setup, access control, and security details, read the Agent Gateway documentation.

The raw OpenAPI document is available at openapi/v1.json.

budget.description: Replacement budget using the campaign's existing monetary unit, discriminated by type (currently cpm). Omit or null preserves the budget. Supply costPerMille; null or omitted maximumTotalCost removes the spending cap.

UpdateCampaignRequest.description: Update approval state, schedule or budget while preserving campaign targeting and promotions.

enabled.description: Whether the merchandising rule should be enabled. Omit this property or set it to null to preserve the current enabled state.

schedule.description: Schedule controlling when the rule is active. Omit this property or set it to null to preserve the entire current schedule. To change or clear schedule bounds, provide a schedule object.

UpdateMerchandisingRuleRequest.description: Settings that control whether and when a merchandising rule is active without changing its definition or targeting configuration.

startsAt.description: UTC date and time when the rule should become active. Set to null to remove the lower time bound.

endsAt.description: UTC date and time when the rule should stop being active. Set to null to remove the upper time bound.

UpdateMerchandisingRuleScheduleRequest.description: UTC time boundaries controlling when a merchandising rule is active.

isApproved.description: Whether the Search Tools rule should be approved and active for matching searches. Omit this property or set it to null to preserve the current approval state.

UpdateSearchToolRuleRequest.description: Settings that update a Search Tools rule without replacing its definition or scope.

values.description: Distinct nonblank classification values preserving their exact casing.

UserClassification.description: A case-sensitive user classification and its available values for the requested period.

displayName.description: The display name of the authenticated user.

emailAddress.description: The email address of the authenticated user.

UserDetails.description: Details about the authenticated My Relewise user.

dataKeys.description: Case-sensitive Data Keys available on users.

classifications.description: Case-sensitive user classifications and their available values for the requested period.

UserMetadata.description: Metadata available for user entities during the requested period.

dataKeys.description: Case-sensitive Data Keys available on variants.

specificationKeys.description: Case-sensitive Variant Data Keys selected as dimensions, such as size or color, for correlating variants across products.

VariantMetadata.description: Metadata available for product variant entities.

Bearer.description: Personal Access Token or OAuth access token sent as a bearer token in the Authorization header.
